title: Resolución 106/2025 del CITMA, Reglamento para las actividades del mercado de carbono
citation: Resolución 106/2025 del Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología y Medio Ambiente, Gaceta Oficial Ordinaria No. 77 (GOC-2025-426-O77), published about 2025-09-19
evidence: No official page opened states the first in-force date. Secondary sources (climate-laws.org; Periódico Cubano) give publication on 2025-09-19 and the register row records entry into force 30 business days after publication. Official site not opened: gacetaoficial.gob.cu reset the connection from the cloud address on 2026-11-03.
notes: Spanish only; Cuba has one official language of legislation. The existing register row had an empty official_source_url; the Gaceta issue page URL could not be found because the site is blocked, so it holds the site root. Looked for a government English translation on gacetaoficial.gob.cu and citma.gob.cu: neither opened, none found.
status_note: Row CU-GACETA-ADOPTED is permission requested; nothing stored.

title: Ley 150 de 2022, Ley del Sistema de los Recursos Naturales y el Medio Ambiente
citation: Ley 150 de 2022 (approved 2022-05-14 or 16 per secondary sources), Gaceta Oficial Ordinaria No. 87 de 2023-09-13 (GOC-2023-771-O87); replaces Ley 81 de 1997
evidence: No official page opened states the first in-force date. Secondary copies of the Gaceta (uclv.edu.cu, leap.unep.org) quote the commencement clause "La presente Ley comienza a regir a los 180 días de su publicación en la Gaceta Oficial de la República de Cuba". Official site not opened: gacetaoficial.gob.cu reset the connection from the cloud address on 2026-11-03.
notes: Environmental framework act, not a climate act. Whether a Decreto reglamentario was published was not checked (site blocked). Spanish only. Looked for a government English translation on gacetaoficial.gob.cu and citma.gob.cu: neither opened, none found.
